verdict.rationale: Thoropass documents a native access review feature. It reminds you to start reviews on your policy's timelines, suggests in-scope critical systems to review, and lets you validate access changes before finishing. It also supports consecutive reviews that reuse prior data (Head Start) and automates gathering evidence for audits, so the core periodic-review-to-evidence loop is covered. missing for 10: explicit documentation that user lists are pulled automatically from connected-app integrations, a documented reviewer sign-off/attestation workflow, confirmation that the completed artifact lands in the evidence library (evidence automation is only 'when applicable'), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
